limitations: Applies to finite Heisenberg Lie algebras of rank at least two with one-dimensional center; not a triangle or spectral enumeration. Historical equivalence in subspace-sum or symplectic-incidence literature remains a risk.
scientific_integrity: Exact all-rank finite-field proof; small prime-field direct enumeration is corroborative only. Published general Frattini blow-up and rank-one Heisenberg case are acknowledged as prior coverage.
title: Exact edge count and symplectic fibers in Heisenberg comaximal graphs
